description.value:
Frequency once per day

Duration 1 minute

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to Seek and to checks to identify magic. For the duration, you can see the faint residue of magic cast within the last 10 minutes as a shimmer, though not its exact effect or caster.
